notes: Model profiles are intentionally empty in repository canon until a concrete runtime/model/revision/rights/pricing tuple is observed and approved.
Use AVENGERS_MODEL_PROFILES_JSON or a protected local registry file to add runtime profiles without storing credentials.
External capability tools are merged by scripts/avengers-arsenal-doctor.mjs from artifacts/external-skill-plugin-registry.json.
Discovery never creates activation. No model is downloaded or arbitrary model code executed by this registry.
